generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL; generated PKs start above the compact max so they never collide with compact rows.
generic_sampling_rules.int_fk: Copy an existing parent primary-key value from the compact parent rows or from generated parent rows; never NULL for NOT NULL FK columns; every generated child FK must resolve to a parent row present in the same instance.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Integer > 0 drawn from a small range around the observed statistics; boundary values from per_column_exceptions.
generic_sampling_rules.real_measure: Real number in the observed range; boundary values from per_column_exceptions.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Random combination of first and last name tokens; allow near-duplicates and repeated values so DISTINCT and GROUP patterns occur.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Short text token from a small pool; allow duplicates.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Date string in the format 'Month D, YYYY'; keep chronological order across rows of the same table.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: One value from the enumerated pool in per_column_exceptions.

supporting_evidence.pattern_targets: Group-size, duplicate-share, tie, HAVING-count and boundary-value targets are query-derived sampling goals (uncertain), not database rules; they are best-effort and not guaranteed by construction at the fixed table sizes.

uncertainty: Pattern targets (group sizes 1/2/>=3, duplicate share 20-50%, ties at rank 1, HAVING COUNT >= 2 with counts 1/2/3, boundary values 23/24/25/26 and 2999/3000/3001) are inferred from query shapes, not from the database, and are marked uncertain. No formulas or order rules were derivable from the sample; only range and enum rules are stated. journal_committee.Editor_ID and journal_committee.Journal_ID are NOT NULL and are not NULL targets; they appear in COUNT operations only.
